# MDL503 · `masquerade-function-prefix`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A masking function is selected by a prefix of a longer word.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | F10 |

## Why

mydumper compares only the start of the value: `constantly 'x'` selects `constant`, `random_intx` selects `random_int`. mydumper then reads the arguments at a fixed offset, so the extra letters become part of them.

## Example

With mydumper v1.0.5-1:

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`email`=constantly x
`age`=random_intx
```

```text
2:9-2:19 warning MDL503[masquerade-function-prefix] `constantly` selects the masking function `constant`: mydumper only compares the start of the value
  = The masking uses `constant`; the rest of the word is read as its arguments.
3:7-3:18 warning MDL503[masquerade-function-prefix] `random_intx` selects the masking function `random_int`: mydumper only compares the start of the value
  = The masking uses `random_int`; the rest of the word is read as its arguments.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL503: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL503` on the line above it.
